name: Generic jet UCAV, loyal-wingman class (illustrative)
description: GENERIC-UCAV with a smaller engine and the F-16C-DCSFIT's g lag: 18.7 kN at 4.55 t, thrust/weight 0.42 (XQ-58A Valkyrie, from public figures: about 8.9 kN at 2.7 t, 0.33; GENERIC-UCAV: 26 kN, 0.58), so a little more optimistic than a Valkyrie-class jet. Every value is illustrative, not data for any real aircraft.
